verdict.rationale: Metorial has a browsable catalog of 1200+ integrations and a key-gated providers REST API. Tool filters reference named tool keys, which implies tools are enumerable per provider. Docs also distinguish hosted custom servers, Magic MCP hosted endpoints, and linked remote MCP servers, which loosely covers hosting attributes. Missing for 10: any documented pre-connection view of a listed server's tool list, input schemas per tool, or transport details, a catalog/provider-detail page or API response showing these attributes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
